metadata.description: Walk — on-device footage triage for photographers. One product, one plugin: this repository is both the marketplace and the pack, because there is nothing else to ship beside it.

plugins.name: walk
plugins.description: Walk decodes video on Apple silicon and finds the frames worth a second look: a whole-frame luminance-rise detector paired with an on-device Vision classifier. Every candidate carries its frame index, timecode, the rise over a local median baseline, 10-bit Y-plane statistics, classifier confidences, and a written thumbnail. The classification runs on the machine, so looking at several thousand frames costs no tokens.

metadata.compatibilityTier: MCP-host-full-operation ONLY, AND macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon (arm64) ONLY — this plugin ships a native Mach-O binary, not a script
metadata.requiresForFullOperation: a host able to launch stdio MCP servers, running macOS 26+ on arm64. There is no Intel build and no non-Apple port: the engine links Vision, CoreML and AVFoundation directly, which is the whole reason the classification runs on-device and costs no tokens.
metadata.note: PHASE 1 SHIPS THE ENGINE AND NO JUDGMENT. Decision #534 rules that the coaching criteria set ships inside this plugin; it does not ship in this phase. Until it does, every scan returns coaching.available=false together with the reason and the paths searched — unless the host has a criteria set of its own installed, in which case that one is loaded and said so. Read the field rather than inferring a verdict. Hosts below the macOS/arch floor get a server advertising zero tools and stating the reason, rather than a silent failure that reads as 'not configured yet'.
